title: <One-line title of the architecture change request>
problem: <Problem statement with evidence: what is broken or missing, backed by issue references, CI runs or ledger facts (spec/architecture-lock.md Section 3).>
evidence: <Evidence item: issue number, governance run id, ledger fact, benchmark, …>
impact: <Current architecture impact: what the change does to the frozen architecture and what it must never do.>
recommendation: <Recommended change, with acceptance criteria the Architect and Product Owner can check.>
migration_plan: <Migration plan: who implements it (work item), what records are created, how existing records remain valid.>
compatibility: <Compatibility / backward-impact analysis: which existing records, registries and checks remain byte-identical.>
security_impact: <Security impact: authority model, what new capability is granted and to whom, tamper evidence.>
provenance: <Optional: where the request originated (an issue, an earlier proposal commit, a review finding).>
